title: Resetting a Locked NovaMail Account & Clearing Auth Tokens
symptoms: User locked out of NovaMail after multiple failed login attempts
Error: AUTH-403 Account Disabled Temporarily
Repeated prompt asking for corporate credentials
resolution_steps: 1. Verify caller identity using 2-factor voice confirmation or employee badge ID.
2. Open the NovaMail Admin Console at identity.corp.internal/admin.
3. Search for the user by corporate email address.
4. Click 'Unlock Account' and select 'Force Invalidation of Active Refresh Tokens'.
5. Have the user clear their local desktop cache: delete ~/.novamail/session_cache or clear browser local storage.
6. Ask the user to re-authenticate with their primary password and approve MFA push.

title: Self-Service Password Reset for Orion HR Portal
symptoms: User forgotten password or expired credential
Error: PWD-EXP-88 Credential Expired
Unable to log into payroll or benefits portal
resolution_steps: 1. Direct user to the self-service portal: sso.internal.corp/self-reset.
2. Guide the user to enter their employee number and registered SMS phone number.
3. Enter the 6-digit one-time verification code received on the mobile device.
4. Enter a new password conforming to corporate policy (min 14 characters, 1 uppercase, 1 symbol, 1 digit).
5. Wait 60 seconds for Active Directory propagation before logging back into Orion HR.

title: Atlas VPN Gateway Timeout and Tunnel Disconnection (ERR-TUNNEL-504)
symptoms: Atlas VPN client hangs at 'Connecting (90%)...'
Error code: ERR-TUNNEL-504 Gateway Negotiation Failed
Sudden disconnect every 10 minutes when working from home
resolution_steps: 1. Disconnect Atlas VPN completely and right-click the system tray icon to select 'Quit'.
2. Open Settings in Atlas VPN client and switch Protocol from UDP to TCP (Port 443 fallback).
3. Change the Gateway region from 'Auto-Detect' to the nearest secondary regional hub (e.g., US-East-02).
4. Flush local DNS: run 'ipconfig /flushdns' (Windows) or 'sudo dscacheutil -flushcache' (macOS).
5. Re-launch Atlas VPN as Administrator and establish connection.

title: Resolving DNS Probe Failure & Internal Intranet Resolution
symptoms: Browser displays: DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN when accessing internal tools
Public websites load normally but internal *.corp.internal links fail
Ping to intranet hostnames returns 'Unknown host'
resolution_steps: 1. Check if the user is connected to corporate VPN (Atlas VPN is required for internal DNS resolution).
2. Verify DNS server settings: Primary must point to 10.100.1.10 and Secondary to 10.100.1.11.
3. Run command prompt as Admin and execute: 'netsh interface ip set dns name="Wi-Fi" source=dhcp'.
4. Clear DNS client cache: 'ipconfig /flushdns'.
5. Restart the 'Dnscache' Windows service or reboot workstation if local hosts file was modified.

title: Zenith CRM Crash on Startup or Memory Leak Exception
symptoms: Zenith CRM closes immediately after splash screen
Error: Exception 0xC0000005 in ZenithCore.dll
App hangs on 'Loading customer pipeline cache...'
resolution_steps: 1. Terminate all orphaned Zenith background processes in Task Manager (ZenithCRM.exe, ZenithWorker.exe).
2. Navigate to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ZenithCRM\Cache\ and delete all files in the 'DataCache' and 'Temp' directories.
3. Ensure the workstation has Microsoft Visual C++ 2019-2022 Redistributable installed.
4. Run Zenith CRM launcher as Administrator and hold Shift key while opening to trigger 'Safe Mode' launch.
5. If error persists, run the Zenith Repair Utility located in C:\Program Files\Zenith CRM\RepairTool.exe.

title: WorkSphere Suite Installation Failure (Error CODE-1603)
symptoms: WorkSphere installer rolls back at 85% progress
MSI installation failed with Fatal Error 1603
Company Portal reports installation error: 0x87D1041C
resolution_steps: 1. Verify that previous partial versions of WorkSphere are completely uninstalled from Control Panel.
2. Clear temp install files: delete all contents of C:\Windows\Temp and %TEMP%.
3. Ensure antivirus real-time inspection is not locking the installer DLLs.
4. Open elevated Command Prompt and execute installer with logging: 'msiexec /i WorkSphereSetup.msi /l*v C:\ws_install.log /qn'.
5. Inspect the generated log if error persists, or push reinstall package via Intune / Company Portal.

title: CloudDesk Virtual Desktop Black Screen or Input Lag
symptoms: CloudDesk opens to a persistent black screen after authentication
Cursor moves but desktop icons and taskbar fail to render
Error: VDI-VIDEO-TIMEOUT Session Dropped
resolution_steps: 1. Press Ctrl + Alt + Delete inside CloudDesk and click 'Sign Out' (do not just close window).
2. In CloudDesk client settings, disable 'Hardware GPU Acceleration' toggle.
3. Switch display setting from 'Full Screen All Monitors' to 'Windowed (1920x1080)'.
4. Re-launch CloudDesk session; this allocates a fresh virtual display driver pipe.
5. If still stuck, restart the virtual workspace session from the CloudDesk Self-Care portal.

title: Fixing External Monitor Flicker and DisplayPort Detection Issues
symptoms: External monitor goes black for 2-3 seconds intermittently
Windows displays 'Display connection might be limited'
Second monitor not detected through USB-C / Thunderbolt dock
resolution_steps: 1. Power-cycle the docking station: unplug power cable from dock, wait 15 seconds, and reconnect.
2. Unplug and re-seat both ends of the DisplayPort / HDMI cable directly into monitor and dock.
3. Lower refresh rate from 144Hz/120Hz to 60Hz in Windows Display Settings > Advanced Display.
4. Open Intel Graphics Command Center / AMD Software and disable 'Display Power Savings'.
5. Update docking station firmware using the Dell/HP Command Update utility.

title: Laptop Battery Draining Rapidly and Excessive Fan Noise
symptoms: Battery life drops from 100% to 20% in under 90 minutes
Cooling fan running at maximum speed constantly
Laptop chassis uncomfortably hot to touch
resolution_steps: 1. Open Task Manager and sort by CPU usage to identify runaway background processes (e.g. indexers or antivirus).
2. Check battery health report: run 'powercfg /batteryreport' in Command Prompt and inspect full charge capacity.
3. Reset the system Power Plan to 'Balanced' and ensure thermal profile is set to 'Cool' or 'Optimized' in BIOS/OEM manager.
4. Clean air vents with compressed air; ensure laptop is operating on a flat, hard surface.
5. If battery cycle count exceeds 800 cycles or health < 60%, schedule hardware battery replacement ticket.

title: Wireless Keyboard and Bluetooth Mouse Unresponsive or Lagging
symptoms: Keyboard keystrokes repeat or lag by several seconds
Mouse cursor stutters or freezes across the screen
Bluetooth device status shows 'Paired' but not connected
resolution_steps: 1. Verify batteries in keyboard and mouse; replace with fresh AA/AAA batteries or recharge via USB-C.
2. If using a 2.4GHz USB receiver dongle, move it away from USB 3.0 ports which cause radio frequency interference (use front port or extension cable).
3. In Device Manager, expand 'Bluetooth', right-click the Bluetooth adapter, and uncheck 'Allow computer to turn off this device to save power'.
4. Remove the Bluetooth device from Settings > Devices, reboot workstation, and re-pair.
5. Reinstall Bluetooth driver from manufacturer support catalog.

title: NovaMail Sync Stalled and Mailbox Storage Quota Exceeded
symptoms: Emails not updating; status bar shows 'Disconnected' or 'Sync pending'
Bounce-back notification: '554 5.2.2 Mailbox is full'
Incoming messages are rejected with quota error
resolution_steps: 1. Advise user to empty the 'Deleted Items' and 'Junk Email' folders permanently.
2. Filter inbox by size (items > 15MB) and export heavy video/PDF attachments to corporate OneDrive / GDrive.
3. Trigger Online Archive: in NovaMail account settings, enable 'Auto-Archive items older than 6 months'.
4. In NovaMail File menu, click 'Compact Now' under Data File Properties to reclaim unallocated disk space.
5. If business necessity dictates, submit Service Catalog request for Mailbox Quota Increase (Tier 2 approval).

title: Meeting Audio and Microphone Permission Denied in Chat & Teams
symptoms: Other participants cannot hear user during voice calls
WorkSphere Teams displays banner: 'Microphone is disabled in system privacy settings'
Mute toggle is greyed out or shows red warning icon
resolution_steps: 1. Check physical hardware mute switch or in-line volume wheel on headset cable.
2. Open OS Privacy Settings > Microphone, and toggle 'Allow desktop apps to access your microphone' to ON.
3. In WorkSphere Teams settings > Devices, explicitly select the USB Headset as primary Audio Device instead of 'Default Communication Device'.
4. Make a test call via Teams Settings > Devices > 'Make a test call' to verify audio waveform capture.
5. Quit WorkSphere, delete %APPDATA%\WorkSphere\teams_audio_cache, and restart the app.

title: Shared Calendar Delegation and Meeting Synchronization Error
symptoms: Meeting invites accepted on mobile do not show up on desktop calendar
Error: 'You do not have permission to modify this calendar event'
Ghost calendar appointments that cannot be deleted or forwarded
resolution_steps: 1. Verify delegate permissions on the primary mailbox: Account Settings > Delegate Access > Editor.
2. In NovaMail Calendar view, right-click the affected shared calendar, select Properties > Clear Offline Items.
3. Click the 'Send/Receive All Folders' button (F9) to force a re-download of calendar items from Exchange server.
4. Disable cached Exchange mode for shared folders: Account Settings > Change > More Settings > Advanced > Uncheck 'Download shared folders'.
5. Restart NovaMail to apply new synchronization profile.

title: Orion HR Portal Session Timeout During Form Submission
symptoms: User submits timesheet or reimbursement and gets bounced to login screen
Error: HTTP 419 Page Expired / CSRF Token Mismatch
Form data lost upon re-authenticating
resolution_steps: 1. Advise user not to keep Orion HR tabs open overnight or longer than 30 minutes without active interaction.
2. Perform a hard browser refresh: Ctrl + F5 (Windows) or Cmd + Shift + R (macOS) to update security cookie tokens.
3. Clear third-party cookies for 'hr.corp.internal' in browser privacy preferences.
4. Verify workstation clock synchronization: if system time drifts by > 3 minutes, SAML SSO tokens fail validation.
5. If issue persists across browsers, reset the user's web session from the Orion Admin dashboard.
